honing_confound: Support effectiveness (healing values, shield amounts) scales with Specialization stat which scales with gear honing. Tier standing as S-tier reflects T4 raid meta where dedicated support is mandatory per raid slot. Solo content tier is much lower — cannot clear chaos dungeons efficiently.

delivery.evidence: Holy Aura radiates from the Paladin in a 12-meter radius, continuously affecting all party members within range. Holy Sword skills (Puncture, Holy Explosion, Word of Light) deal melee/medium-range damage as secondary output.

footprint.evidence: Holy Aura: 12-meter continuous radius zone centered on caster. This is the largest persistent AoE in the warrior archetype. Shield skills (Sacred Protection, Wrath of God) apply to nearby allies in zone.

geo_text: Paladin as persistent zone-support. Holy Aura maintains a 12m radius buff zone around the caster that provides HoT, damage reduction, and damage amplification passively to all allies within. Active skills land at melee/medium range for modest personal damage. The spatial identity is 'be near your party and stand near the boss' — positioning serves the aura radius, not personal damage.

control.evidence: Blessed Aura Paladin does not rely on CC. Judgment Stigmata can apply a debuff. Primary identity is support, not control.

defense.evidence: For ALLIES: shields via Sacred Protection + damage reduction via Holy Aura. For SELF: Paladin has heavy armor type and some personal shield. The defense layer is outward-facing (protecting party) more than self-defensive. Healing over Time (HoT) is the sustain layer.

economy.resource_verbatim: Piety (Identity Gauge — fills via Piety-generating skills)
economy.builder_source: Holy Sword skills (Puncture, Holy Explosion, Wrath of God, Word of Light) generate Piety. Most active skills in Blessed Aura rotation generate Piety as their primary purpose.
economy.plain_text: Piety fills from Piety-generating skills. Two spend options: (1) Holy Aura (W key) — continuous zone support; must be actively maintained with Piety; this is the PRIMARY spend in Blessed Aura. (2) Sacred Executioner — DPS identity (suppressed in Blessed Aura build). Blessed Aura modifies Holy Aura to add HoT + damage reduction on top of the base +10% damage buff to allies.

element.evidence: Paladin skills deal Holy damage (distinct from Physical/Magic — Holy is a Light-element damage type in LA). Judgment Stigmata also deals Holy.

movement.evidence: Low mobility class. Paladin must position near party to maintain aura. No dash in primary kit. Flash Kick provides brief positioning but is not a primary skill.

attr.evidence: Must stay in melee range of boss (to contribute Piety via Holy Sword skills) and near party (to maintain aura coverage). Dual positioning pressure.

range.evidence: Holy Aura radius = 12m. Personal damage skills = 0-6m melee range.

tempo.evidence: Blessed Aura is a sustained support identity: Holy Aura is maintained continuously. No burst windows for the support function; the HoT and damage reduction are permanent within range.

amp.value: Party +10% damage dealt + HoT + damage reduction (via Holy Aura, Blessed Aura modifier)
amp.evidence: Blessed Aura modifies Holy Aura from pure damage-buff to damage-buff + HoT + damage reduction. The +10% damage dealt to enemies is the primary party amplification axis.

commitment.evidence: Most Paladin support skills are instant-cast buffs/heals. Holy Sword active skills have brief animations but support utility is cast-instant or continuous-aura.

mechanics_notes: 1) Blessed Aura Paladin is one of two dedicated group-support slots in LA endgame raids (other is Bard). GROUP-CONTEXT NOTE: The entire identity is worthless without party members — solo DPS is non-functional as primary content vehicle. Curation prediction: system-record/negative for solo per C2 ruling. 2) The Paladin's rare duality (support-class-with-DPS-option-via-Judgment) makes it the clearest test of the C2 ruling in the corpus: the DPS identity (Judgment) is also in this file, allowing direct comparison. 3) Blessed Aura Paladin is the genre's strongest 'must-have support slot' example: nearly 100% of LA endgame parties include one. Zero solo-PvE equivalence. 4) Counter skill (Flash Kick) — each class has one counter; Paladin's is instant-cast. No engine equivalent.
stabilization_patch: Blessed Aura dominant from day one; never displaced as the primary support Paladin identity.
tier_standing_release: S-tier (support) — mandatory raid slot from launch
tier_standing_current: S-tier (support slot). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: This tier is exclusively for group-content; solo tier is D/F (unplayable as primary chaos dungeon spec).

honing_confound: Judgment Paladin damage output is below average for DPS classes at all honing tiers. Tier standing reflects this consistently across tiers — not a honing-ceiling artifact but an inherent class design constraint. Solo content (chaos dungeons) tier is improved vs Blessed Aura.

delivery.evidence: Punishment (Punish) skills are the primary DPS tools: Holy Sword attacks, Executor's Sword, Spear of Judgement. These are melee or short-range holy sword/lance attacks.

footprint.evidence: Punish skills land in frontal cones or small AoE at impact. Spear of Judgement is a mid-range targeted throw (~8m). Overall footprint similar to Combat Readiness.

geo_text: Judgment Paladin brings the same spatial identity as Blessed Aura — melee/medium range — but without the persistent aura zone. Sacred Executioner (DPS transformation identity) creates a brief window where all Punish skills are enhanced. Still primarily frontal-cone melee attacks.

control.evidence: Judgment Stigmata applies a damage debuff to targets, making Judgment the closest to having a 'control' rider in the Paladin kit. But the identity is DPS, not control.

defense.evidence: Judgment Paladin loses meaningful support-defensive value. Heavy armor type provides baseline tankiness. No persistent shield output for self or party.

economy.builder_source: Punish skills generate +100% Piety in Judgment identity. Primary builders: Holy Explosion, Wrath of God, Executor's Sword, Spear of Judgement.
economy.plain_text: Piety generation doubled (Judgment engraving effect). Spends on Sacred Executioner (Z): DPS transformation mode. Sacred Executioner duration doubled (Judgment effect). In Sacred Executioner: Punish skills deal significantly more damage. The loop is fill Piety → activate Sacred Executioner → burst with Punish skills → repeat. Holy Aura is still available but secondary.

element.evidence: Same Holy damage type as Blessed Aura; Punish skills deal Holy damage. Spear of Judgement has Holy projectile delivery.

movement.evidence: Same low-mobility profile. Sacred Executioner grants no movement enhancement.

range.evidence: Spear of Judgement extends effective range to ~8m. Most Punish skills still melee.

tempo.evidence: Judgment centers on Sacred Executioner activation windows — fill Piety, enter burst DPS mode, spend, repeat. Build-release rhythm.

amp.value: Sacred Executioner: enhanced Punish skills during window; Judgment Stigmata debuff on enemies
amp.evidence: Sacred Executioner is the DPS amplification. Exact percentages not verified from live source — sourced from training knowledge. Conf reduced to 0.8.

commitment.evidence: Punish skills have deliberate charge animations. Spear of Judgement has a throw animation.

mechanics_notes: 1) Judgment Paladin is the premier example in LA of a 'misfit DPS' — a class that CAN do DPS but is below-average at it and primarily exists as support in raid contexts. Parties rarely want a Judgment Paladin in endgame raids (opportunity cost: a Blessed Aura Paladin provides party value; a Judgment Paladin provides subpar personal DPS). 2) C2 RULING RELEVANCE: Judgment is the CLOSEST Paladin identity to 'solo viable' — it can clear solo content. But even Judgment is below average DPS; it's not a competitive solo archetype vs specialist DPS classes. Curation flag: Judgment = borderline; Blessed Aura = definitive group-context negative per C2. 3) The Judgment/Blessed Aura split is the clearest example in LA of an identity fork where one fork is entirely group-context and the other is solo-functional but underperforming. This binary is load-bearing evidence for the C2 ruling's 'group support has no solo equivalent' claim.
stabilization_patch: Judgment has never been dominant; consistently niche from launch.
tier_standing_current: C-tier (solo/chaos content); D-tier (raid). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: tier reflects class design, not honing — Judgment is consistently below-average at all tiers.
